title: should activate the matching tab when deep-linking to a valid non-default tab
verifies: a deep link with a valid tab id activates that tab and retains tab=<id> in the URL

title: should fall back to the default tab and normalize the URL when deep-linking without a tab param
verifies: a tab-less deep link activates the first (default) tab and writes tab=default back into the URL

title: should fall back to the default tab and normalize the URL when deep-linking with an invalid tab param
verifies: a stale deep link (nonexistent tab id) falls back to the default tab and rewrites the URL to tab=default

title: should resolve a tab when clicking add panel from a tab-less deep link (null-safety regression)
verifies: clicking Add panel from a tab-less deep link navigates to add_panel carrying tab=default (the null-safety guard)

title: should fall back to the default tab when deep-linking with an empty tab param
verifies: an empty tab= param matches no tab id and falls back to the default tab, normalizing the URL to tab=default
